messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: 2xx error spike + increased tail latency on /v1/generate for model=edge-llama-v6 in eu-west1. Paging Priya (on-call).
Priya: I'm on it. Seeing about 15% 5xx rate and p95 latency jumped from 280ms -> 1.2s starting ~08:42 UTC. Which keys?
Sam: Top offenders are a handful of heavy keys from Partner A and an internal batch job. Keys: partner-a-prod, ingestion-cron.
Jess: I'm seeing KV cache misses skyrocketing on v6 instances; error traces show OOM-ish failures in the quantized path.
Priya: Repro: hitting v6 in eu-west1 with small prompt gives immediate reloads, logs show "kv_cache_eviction: failed to allocate slab" across hosts. Not confident we can fix quickly.
Ryan: Can we steer traffic to edge-llama-v5 (stable) for eu-west1 and reduce v6 to 0%? We should also put emergency quotas on partner-a-prod.
Priya: Agreed. Plan: 1) Apply temporary key quotas for the heavy keys 2) Disable edge-llama-v6 routing for eu-west1, failover to edge-llama-v5 3) Monitor errors and latency for 30m then reassess. Anyone object?
Mike: No objections. Remind: we need to coordinate with Dedicated customers if they're pinned. I think partner-a is hosted though.
Jess: Quick check: v5 supports same ABI and config? Verified, v5 is compatible for current routing. No model-signature changes.
Priya: OK doing step 1 now: apply soft quota 100 req/min to partner-a-prod and 50 req/min to ingestion-cron. Command: ```/admin quota set partner-a-prod 100 --scope=eu-west1``` and ```/admin quota set ingestion-cron 50```
ops-bot: Quota update successful for partner-a-prod -> 100 r/m (eu-west1). Quota update successful for ingestion-cron -> 50 r/m.
Priya: Step 2: disable routing of model=edge-llama-v6 in eu-west1. Using rollout API: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN' \  https://control-plane/redwood/v1/rollouts -d '{"target":"eu-west1","model":"edge-llama-v6","action":"suspend"}'```
ops-bot: Rollout job created id=rb-9244.
Sam: ops-bot shows gradual drain across 6 hosts, demote weight to 0 over 60s. Watching routing table.
ops-bot: Route update: edge-llama-v6 weight eu-west1 -> 0%. Fallback rule: route to edge-llama-v5.
Priya: Observability: errors dropped from 15% -> 2% within 90s, p95 latency back to ~320ms. Good sign.
Jess: KV miss rate dropped on hosts that were failing. No new OOM logs.
Ryan: Confirmed traffic for partner-a now hitting edge-llama-v5. No customer pages yet.
Mike: Notifying Partner A support workaround: "We've temporarily routed your traffic to the stable variant (edge-llama-v5) while we investigate v6 in eu-west1. No action needed but expect slight perf difference."
Priya: Sending message to customers now. Also opening a dedicated incident ticket for the v6 regression.
Priya: Incident note: impact: increased error and latency for hosted users in eu-west1 during 08:42-08:44 UTC. Mitigation: rate-limits + immediate model routing rollback to v5 in eu-west1.
Jess: Next: collect runtime heap/kv metrics and core dumps from affected v6 instances. I'll attach trace ids.
Sam: Creating collection job: ```/infra collect-metrics --hosts tag:v6-eu-west1 --since=08:40```
ops-bot: Metric collection job queued id=mc-391.
Priya: On-call handoff @ 09:00 UTC — I'll keep monitoring for 15min then hand to Sam for deeper root-cause. Sam take over?
Sam: I'll take. Priya, leave a short playbook in the ticket for escalation to runtime team (Jess + Ryan).
Priya: Done. Playbook: 1) check slab allocator pressure, 2) confirm quant path memory guardrails, 3) consider rolling a patched quant kernel or temporarily disable quant-optimized variant for v6.
Ryan: If v6 needs a kernel rollback, we should not roll that live without canary. For now keeping v6 suspended in eu-west1. Consider limited canary in us-central for debug only.
Mike: Should we also tighten global per-key quotas for a few minutes to avoid re-triggering while we debug?
Priya: Yes — global throttle for unknown heavy keys: set 60 r/m default for EU region. ```/admin quota set --region=eu-west1 --default 60```
ops-bot: Global default quota updated for eu-west1 -> 60 r/m.
Priya: Monitoring looks stable for 12m, errors stayed <3% and latency at baseline. I'll mark mitigation in ticket and change incident state to "mitigated".
incident-bot: Incident 2026-1745678901 set to MITIGATED by Priya at 08:58 UTC.
Priya: Sam has the on-call lead for follow-up. I'll brief runtime team. Thanks everyone.
Sam: Follow-up actions assigned: - Jess: attach core dumps + kernel traces (ETA 4h) - Ryan: workload replay to reproduce mem pressure (ETA 6h) - Ops: plan safe rollout/patch for v6, include canary in us-central.
Laura: I'll draft customer comms postmortem summary and flag any enterprise accounts for follow-up calls.
Priya: Final note: DO NOT re-enable v6 in eu-west1 until signoff from runtime team. If we need to reintroduce, use 1% canary with strict quotas for 30m.
Sam: Acknowledged. Handoff complete. Closing thread here, will update ticket with root-cause and next steps.
incident-bot: Remember to start postmortem within 72 hours and include promptsets that triggered the segfault.
